name: sec_get_company_facts
description:
Every XBRL financial fact a company has reported, from the EDGAR companyfacts API, by CIK or ticker.
Returns {cik, entity_name, facts: {taxonomy: {concept: {label, description, units: {unit: [{end, val, fy, fp, form, filed, accn, ...}]}}}}}. The response is large.
Inputs (* required): cik or ticker (one of them is needed; cik, 10 digits or shorter, wins when both are given; a ticker is resolved through the SEC company-tickers file).
For one metric use sec_get_financial_data or edgar_company_concept; edgar_company_facts is the CIK-only variant with counts.
Example: {"ticker": "AAPL"}
No API key; SEC data.sec.gov (requests are not throttled; the SEC allows 10 per second).

cik.description: Central Index Key (CIK) - 10 digit company identifier

facts.description: XBRL facts organized by taxonomy (us-gaap, dei, etc.)

additionalProperties.description: Facts for a specific taxonomy containing hundreds of financial metrics

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Returns comprehensive XBRL financial data. Can be large (megabytes). Use sec_get_financial_data for specific metrics.

examples.description: Get all XBRL facts for Apple
Get structured financial data for Tesla

metadata.warning: This endpoint returns ALL financial facts and can be very large (>5MB). Consider using sec_get_financial_data for specific metrics.
